prompts.text: Use the Flux server to read the file at absolute path /tmp/mada_flux_eval/input/job_script.sh.
Please open the job script for me from /tmp/mada_flux_eval/input/job_script.sh using the Flux MCP server so I can inspect its contents.

Submit a Flux job that runs command python simulate.py --case blast --steps 10. Request 2 nodes, 4 tasks per node, time limit 30m, job name blast_eval, and working directory /tmp/mada_flux_eval/blast_job.

I need a Flux batch job for the blast study. Launch python simulate.py --case blast --steps 10 from /tmp/mada_flux_eval/blast_job, ask for two nodes with four tasks on each node, cap it at 30 minutes, and label the job blast_eval.
Flux submit_job: command="python simulate.py --case blast --steps 10", nodes=2, tasks_per_node=4, time_limit=30m, job_name=blast_eval, working_directory=/tmp/mada_flux_eval/blast_job.
Check Flux job status for job ID job_000123.
Can you look up the current status of Flux job job_000123 for me?
Check Flux job status for all tracked jobs. Do not pass any job ID.

Flux status for all jobs, no job_id.

Use Flux submit_jobs_async with this exact literal JSON string for run_info_json: {"runs":[{"id":"run_001","run_location":"/tmp/mada_flux_eval/run_001","command":"simulate_case","args":["--input","case1.deck"]},{"id":"run_002","run_location":"/tmp/mada_flux_eval/run_002","command":"simulate_case","args":["--input","case2.deck"]}]}.

Execute two generated runs synchronously through Flux. One run is run_sync_001 at /tmp/mada_flux_eval/run_sync_001 with simulate_case --input sync1.deck, and the other is run_sync_002 at /tmp/mada_flux_eval/run_sync_002 with simulate_case --input sync2.deck.
